mia_conformal: Leave-one-out conformal p-values among 20 exchangeable phantoms are a permutation of {1/20,...,20/20}, so exactly one phantom has p = 1/20 <= 0.05 in every row: the 1/20 phantom rate holds by construction and is the exact level, not evidence of validity; validity rests on exchangeability of phantom and deleted subjects under the null.
